icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Mysteries Above, matching the approved pixel-art ability icon sets. Full-canvas icon only, no sheet, atlas, grid, montage or presentation margin. High-quality disciplined PIXEL ART on a strict 32x32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID magnified as crisp nearest-neighbor square blocks. Broad connected clusters, stepped shadows, main silhouette about 24 logical pixels, readable at actual 24x24 wheel/book list size and 32x32 book detail size. Important edges at least 2 logical pixels, few speckles. No painterly detail, gradients, antialiasing, 3D or photorealism. Simple SILVER SQUARE BEVEL FRAME at absolute canvas edges, ONE logical pixel wide (3.125 percent canvas per side): pale #AAAAB4 top/left, charcoal #4B4C58 bottom/right, dark inset. No outside black margin or ornate corners. Nearly black indigo interior #0C1021 and clear dark negative space. WHITETOWER primary exact #7686E1 (118,134,225): luminous PERIWINKLE BLUE with a violet undertone, not Tyrant cobalt, Door cyan, Fool purple or Sun gold. Primary pathway color must dominate roughly two thirds of lit colored clusters. Deep indigo #293259 shadows, lighter periwinkle #B4BFF4, tiny pearl-white magical cores. Harmonious secondary accents serve the ability: warm brass navigation/ritual objects, copper skin/leather, turquoise spectral facets, small amber impacts or spell fire, muted red curse fissures. Controlled contrast and local glow without fuzzy bloom or excessive white. Every ability has a unique composition, silhouette and action. No text, letters, numerals, runes, glyphs, diagrams with labels, watermark, UI overlay, musical notation, universal tower or all-seeing-eye emblem. Specific ability subject and composition: Oblique TOP-DOWN view of a square dark stone altar, FOUR thick ivory candles clearly placed around a central offering of a small pale gemstone and herb sprig. Small orange candle flames illuminate warm wax, but the much larger rising periwinkle magical column between candles remains dominant. A single crescent of periwinkle light wraps the offering; no book, no pentagram, no written sigils. Actual altar-and-offering ritual, not a generic wizard spell.
